note: Enhanced 7-day sweep across LinkedIn (indexed), Indeed, ZipRecruiter, CareerBuilder, Mediabistro, and fractional/interim comms networks. As on recent runs, general web search returned mostly aggregators, directories, and staffing/marketplace pages rather than fresh, dated, named end-client postings — no bot scraping of LinkedIn was used per policy. Two are strong financial-sector fits (GrowTal, Select Advisors Institute). Deduped against all prior pr-freelance reports (Hanson Search, Wilson PR, Chameleon Collective, Forthright Advising, MassMutual, Four Pines Fund, JIH PR, The PR Net, OpenText, Pinterest, Hello Human, The Work Crowd, ICA Fund, Go Fractional, Crackle PR, KCSA excluded).
